answer: At low tide every agent must pass a tide-gate carrying one shale token stamped with that day's plume signal, a beacon that changes hourly. Peers at the gate check each token against the open shale ledger; a token with the wrong plume is turned away and its stake is kept. Faking 1,000 identities would need 1,000 shale stakes of 40 POA and 1,000 tide-gate crossings in one hour, about 40,000 POA locked, while honest agents cross once for free and keep their stake. Sybils cannot ride the same tide twice, like one smuggler slipping a thousand boats past the same gate at dawn.
